name: cmu-re-sys-time
author: CMU-Revised
description: Sets the Linux clock from the hardware RTC at boot, with a fix for stock timed waits that break on a real clock.

files.reason: boot hook runs the clock set once, before system manager starts any JCI service (stock never sets it: 1970)

fix for stock sem_timedwait / pthread_mutex_timedlock / pthread_timedjoin_np waits whose deadline is taken on the monotonic clock: on a real clock they expire at once (clock, timezone and GPS time changes are dropped)
loads the timed-wait fix into every process
